item.title: Hormuz Fuel Exports’ Slow Recovery Keeps Prices Near Record
item.description: [Bloomberg] Oil-product exports through the Strait of Hormuz are slowly recovering, but the pace hasn’t been enough to prevent a surge in fuel prices that is squeezing consumers around the world.
